skills.name: Timid Courage
skills.description: Dori gains a shield for 3 seconds, knocking back and damaging nearby enemies.

skills.name: Banner Twirl
skills.description: After a short delay, Dori attacks enemies in the surrounding area of ​​the ring, slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. She also gains 15% movement speed for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Starlit Parade
skills.description: After a short delay, Dori attacks enemies in a large ring area, stunning them for 1 second.

name: Dyrroth
title: Prince of the Abyss

skills.description: When Dyrroth's Rage reaches 50%, he will upgrade Burst Strike – Abyss Enhanced and Specter Step – Abyss Enhanced. After every 2 basic attacks, Dyrroth will cast the skill Circle Strike|, dealing enemies in the circle and regenerating pd HP (Circle Strike has no ATK effect). Every time it hits an enemy hero, the CD of Burst Strike and Specter Step will be decreased by 1 second.

skills.name: Burst Strike
skills.description: Dyrroth launches a burst strike in a designated direction. Each burst deals damage to enemies and Slows them by 25% for 1.5 seconds. (Damage decreases against the same target and decreases to only 75%|hp on minions.) Abyss Enhanced|skill: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals 140% of the original damage|hp, and its slow effect is doubled.

skills.name: Spectre Step
skills.description: Dyrroth rushes in the direction indicated. It will stop when it hits a [non-minion] target, dealing damage to enemies. When he uses this skill again, he will lock on to a target and deliver a fatal strike, dealing [a total of]. Enemy Heroes or Creeps hit by Fatal Strike will have their Physical Defense reduced by 40% for 4 seconds. skills.name: Abysm Strike
skills.description: After a short delay, Dyrroth launches a destructive strike in the targeted direction (cannot be interrupted), dealing damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 55% for 0.8 seconds.

relationNotes.assist: Dyrroth's high melee burst damage works best with heroes with single-target CC, such as Franco and Kaja.
relationNotes.strong: Dyrroth has good chasing abilities and good melee burst damage, he is strong against heroes with poor Mobility, such as Gord and Hanabi.
relationNotes.weak: Being a melee hero makes Dyrroth weak against heroes with Slow and kiting abilities, such as Vexana and Belerick.

name: Edith
title: Ancient Guard

skills.name: Overload
skills.description: After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become overcharged for 3 seconds, during which all basic attacks will unleash chains of lightning, dealing additional magic damage equal to up to 4 enemies. Chain Lightning damage against minions is increased to 150%.

skills.name: Earth Shatter
skills.description: After a 0.75 second delay, Edith controls Phylax to deliver a devastating blow in a designated direction, dealing 120% damage to minions to enemies hit and knocking them into the air for 1 second. This skill will not be interrupted by regular control effects (excluding Suppression).

skills.name: Onward
skills.description: Edith controls Phylax to charge in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way. If Phylax hits an enemy hero during this process, he will immediately stop and throw them over his shoulder and deal damage.

skills.name: Primal Wrath
skills.description: Passive: While inside Phylax, Edith can accumulate Wrath based on the damage she receives (calculated before damage reduction). Active: Edith ejects from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies. After that, she takes flight and can perform ranged basic attacks, each dealing damage. Edith also learns new skills in this state. While flying, Edith gains 350 to 650 to 350 to 650 points of additional shield, 50 to 150% additional attack speed, and 5 to 20% hybrid lifesteal depending on how much anger she has accumulated, and converts each point of additional physical defense and additional magic defense into 3.5 magic power. The flight state lasts up to 8-12 seconds.

skills.name: Divine Retribution
skills.description: Edith imposes a divine smite on a target area, dealing 170 (+40% total magic power) magic damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. It then continues to deal 68 (+16% total magic power) magic damage to enemies in the area every 0.5 sec for the next 1.5 sec.

skills.name: Lightning Bolt
skills.description: Edith fires a bolt of lightning in a designated direction, dealing 150 (+50% total Magic Power) magic damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Rooting them for 0.8 seconds.

lore: Forsaken Warden with sealed memories.

relationNotes.assist: Edith works best with heroes like Minotaur and Atlas that can more reliably CC a target first, allowing her to follow up with her own CC.
relationNotes.strong: Edith is strong against heroes that are not very agile and on the fragile side, such as Zilong and Aulus, because her skills deal enough burst damage to eliminate them after connecting with her 2nd Skill.
relationNotes.weak: Edith is countered by Marksmen that can negate CC like Hanabi and Wanwan, since she will have a hard time locking them down.

name: Esmeralda
title: Astrologer

skills.name: Starmoon Casket
skills.description: Esmeralda manipulates Stardust and Frostmoon: Stardust deals physical damage while Frostmoon deals magic damage and gives the target a shield equal to 135% of the damage dealt by Frostmoon. Each basic attack deals and. Esmeralda's damage ignores all shield effects and gradually converts her shield into HP.

skills.name: Frostmoon Shield
skills.description: Esmeralda gains 40% Movement Speed ​​which rapidly decreases for 4 seconds. During this time, she gradually transforms the shields of nearby enemies into her own shield, capped at 50% of her Max HP.

skills.name: Stardust Dance
skills.description: Esmeralda waves Stardust and Frostmoon, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Each time she damages a hero, Frostmoon Shield's cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds (damaging non-hero units grant a reduction of 0.5 seconds) and the enemy's movement speed is reduced by 10% for 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Falling Starmoon
skills.description: Esmeralda brings together the power of Astrospace in her two weapons: Stardust and Frostmoon. The longer this skill is channeled, the longer the casting range. Use Again|e: Esmeralda casts Stardust at the target location, dealing it, then flashes to the target location and casts Frostmoon, dealing and immobilizing enemies in the area for 1 second.

lore: A mysterious astrologer.

relationNotes.assist: Esmeralda works best with heroes that can pull enemies together like Atlas and Tigreal to allow her to hit more targets with her Ultimate.
relationNotes.strong: Esmeralda works well against heroes with shields, like Akai and Lolita, because her skills not only ignore their shields, but she also converts them into her own.
relationNotes.weak: Esmeralda is countered by highly mobile Marksmen, such as Karrie and Lesley, because she lacks the burst damage to finish them off quickly and can't keep up with their mobility.

name: Estes
title: Moon Elf King

skills.name: Scripture of the Moon Elf
skills.description: The Moon Elf Scriptures slowly charge Estes with energy. When the energy reaches 100 charges, the Estes' Nest's basic attack will be enhanced, dealing damage to the target and nearby enemies and slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Moonlight Immersion
skills.description: Estes immediately restores the target hero and bonds with them for 3 seconds, slowly healing back towards the target. Bonding with an allied hero will also increase Estes' hybrid defense by 20-45 and movement speed by 15%, as well as increase the energy charge speed of the Moon Elf's Scriptures. Being too far from the target will break the link. (Improved:|e Estes immediately restores the target hero and bonds with them for 3 seconds, slowly healing back to the target 15 times...)

skills.name: Domain of Moon Goddess
skills.description: Estes projects a flood of moonlight onto the target area, dealing damage to enemy units there. Then it turns to a Moon Goddess domain and reveals the enemies inside [for 1.5 seconds]. Enemies will be slowed by 90% for 1.5 seconds when touching the edge of the domain area. (The slow effect will diminish over time.)[time needed]

skills.name: Blessing of Moon Goddess
skills.description: Estes casts an enhanced (enhanced) Moonlight Immersion on all friendly heroes nearby. In the next 8 seconds, "Moonlight Immersion" will be enhanced and Estes will continuously recover.

lore: Elf King who rules the Moon Elves.

relationNotes.assist: Estes works best with typical Marksman heroes, his healing will allow them to deal more damage. Heroes like Lesley and Hanabi are good examples here.
relationNotes.strong: Estes counters heroes with no burst damage, he can easily heal through minor damages from heroes like Faramis and Alice.
relationNotes.weak: Estes is countered by heroes with high burst damage. Heroes like Saber and Eudora can easily burst down Estes or the hero he protects in a few seconds.

name: Eudora
title: Lightning Weaver

skills.name: Superconductor
skills.description: Eudora's skills inflict Superconductor on affected non-minion units for 5 seconds and can trigger additional effects against enemies affected by Superconductor.

skills.name: Forked Lightning
skills.description: Eudora casts Forked Lightning in a fan-shaped area, dealing (increased to 200% against minions) to enemies inside. When you hit targets affected by Superconductor. Eudora forms a chain of lightning with the target. gaining 40% movement speed while chaining for up to 1 second. The lightning chain expands over time and extra when it ends. If this hit succeeds, it reduces the skill's cooldown by 50%.

skills.name: Ball Lightning
skills.description: Eudora launches an orb of lightning at the targeted enemy, reducing their magic defense from 10 to 25 for 1.8 seconds, damaging and stunning them for 1 second. If the target is affected by Superconductor, the lightning orb reduces the magic defense of nearby enemies, deals AOE damage focused on the target, and stuns all nearby enemies.

skills.name: Thunder's Wrath
skills.description: Eudora fires a bolt of lightning at the target area, dealing damage to targets in the center. Then he hits targets off center and inflicts them. Whenever Thunder's Wrath hits a target affected by the Superconductor, it triggers an explosion centered on the Superconductor's target after a short delay, dealing damage.

lore: The elven mage who commands lightning at her fingertips to pierce prejudice and illuminate the path forward.

relationNotes.assist: Eudora's skills can deal massive AOE damage, so pairing her with heroes who can group enemies, like Diggie and Tigreal, will make it easier to maximize her damage.
relationNotes.strong: Eudora possesses strong targeted CC and burst capabilities, allowing her to keep squishy heroes like Moskov and Obsidia in check.
relationNotes.weak: Eudora lacks self-preservation and struggles against dive heroes or Assassins who can negate targeted CC, such as Hayabusa and Kadita.

name: Fanny
title: Blade Dancer

skills.name: Air Superiority
skills.description: During combat, Fanny deals 10-20% more damage to enemies hit (scales with flight speed ) and applies a stack of Prey Mark|mark (up to 2 stacks) to them with each attack. His subsequent skills on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack. Energy restoration is reduced if it hits multiple enemy heroes in a short period of time.

skills.name: Tornado Strike
skills.description: Fanny spins her blades, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Steel Cable
skills.description: Fanny pulls a cable in the target direction which pulls her to the first obstacle encountered. She can cast this skill again within 2 seconds until her energy is depleted. Each successive cast reduces the energy cost of the skill by 2. Fanny automatically casts Tornado Strike when she hits an enemy in mid-air, as long as her energy is sufficient.

skills.name: Cut Throat
skills.description: Fanny jumps on the targeted enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing damage. Each stack of the target's Prey Mark increases this damage by 30%.

price.other: Obtained via the [[MLBB × Attack on Titan]] event

lore: A blade dancer in the battlefield.

relationNotes.assist: Fanny works best with heroes that can chain AOE CC to keep the enemy pinned, such as Minotaur and Gatotkaca, so she can deal damage without interruption.
relationNotes.strong: Fanny counters squishy heroes that lack targeted CC like Karrie and Irithel who cannot stop Fanny's extreme mobility while she bursts them down.
relationNotes.weak: Fanny is countered by heroes that can restrict mobility, such as Kaja and Khufra, since they can easily shutdown her main advantage.

name: Faramis
title: Soul Binder

skills.name: Vicious Retrieval
skills.description: Every 4 seconds, Faramis' next skill against enemy heroes and summoned items generates a Soul Fragment on the spot. Faramis can absorb the soul fragment to restore it and gain 2 additional magical powers (up to 40 stacks). Upon death, he consumes the absorbed Soul Fragments to reduce the respawn time, each reducing the time by 3% (up to 90%). Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance [how much?] to drop Soul Fragments.

skills.name: Shadow Stampede
skills.description: Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3 seconds, gaining 70% additional movement speed, 25 additional physical and magical defense, 20% reduction in the cooldown of this skill, and the ability to move around the field. Enemy heroes who come into contact with Faramis in this state receive a Nether Mark. Leaving the Shadow state, Faramis drags all marked enemy heroes towards him and distributes them. Use it again to exit the Shadow state early and drag marked enemies towards him. The absorption range of Soul Fragments is increased when this skill is active.

skills.name: Ghost Bursters
skills.description: Faramis gathers Nether energy into a fan-shaped area, attacking enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce back to nearby enemies, dealing (will split up to 2 times on enemy hero hits and 1 time on non-enemy hero hits).

skills.name: Nether Realm
skills.description: Faramis transforms his environment into the Nether Realm for 6 seconds, causing the affected allied hero (including himself) to enter the Ghost state and granting him +% increased HP and 50% increased movement speed for 1 second. When the Ghost state breaks, the hero will clear all debuffs and enter a brief resurrection state for 1 second. An allied hero's Ghost state ends when they leave the Void Realm.

lore: A necromancer in Necrokeep who's determined to find a cure for the Mist.

relationNotes.assist: Faramis works well with heroes that are designed to dive into the enemy, such as Leomord and Martis, as he'll be able to maximize the life-saving effect of his Ultimate.
relationNotes.strong: Faramis' ability to temporarily prevent teammates from being killed makes him a good pick against heroes that go all-in to burst down a target, like Saber and Eudora.
relationNotes.weak: Faramis is countered by high mobility heroes that are difficult for him to catch with his 1st Skill, such as Novaria and Pharsa.

name: Floryn
title: The Budding Hope

skills.name: Dew
skills.description: The Dew Lantern will permanently increase Floryn's attributes by a small amount. Floryn will never sell the Lantern.

skills.name: Sow
skills.description: Floryn throws an energy seed at a targeted enemy, dealing damage. Healing Fruits will then appear and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring them.

skills.name: Sprout
skills.description: Floryn projects a blob of energy in front of him that explodes when it hits an enemy, dealing damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.5 seconds (and briefly revealing their positions). [time required]

skills.name: Bloom
skills.description: Floryn resonates with Dew's power, healing all allied heroes 2x, no matter where they are. This effect also increases their Shield and HP Regeneration effects by 12% for 2 seconds.

relationNotes.assist: Floryn works well with tanky Fighters, such as Terizla and Thamuz, because they are easier to keep alive with heals and can peel enemies off of her.
relationNotes.strong: Floryn excels at sustained healing and counters Tanks with low damage output, such as Uranus and Lolita.
relationNotes.weak: Floryn is countered by high mobility and burst damage Assassins, like Karina and Saber.

name: Franco
title: Frozen Warrior

skills.name: Wasteland Force
skills.description: If no damage is taken within 5 seconds, Franco gains 10% movement speed, recovers 1% maximum HP per second, and begins accumulating Wasteland Force|e (up to 10 stacks). Franco will consume all stacks of Wasteland Force during his next skill to increase the skill's damage by up to 150%.

skills.name: Iron Hook
skills.description: Franco throws an iron hook in the target direction. The hook will snag the first enemy unit hit, dragging it towards Franco.

skills.name: Fury Shock
skills.description: Franco goes on a rampage, dealing physical damage equal to 300-450 plus 4% of his maximum HP to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

skills.description: Franco suppresses the targeted enemy hero for 1.8 seconds and hits them 6 times for the duration, dealing damage each time.

relationNotes.assist: Heroes with high burst damage such as Vale, Karina and Brody to take advantage of his CC.
relationNotes.strong: Heroes with low mobility like Vale, Estes and Layla.
relationNotes.weak: Heroes with high mobility or Control Immunity such as Wanwan, Fanny and Badang.

name: Fredrinn
title: Rogue Appraiser

skills.name: Piercing Strike
skills.description: Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds. His next basic attack gains additional attack range and deals. [Skill duration required] This skill deals 200% damage to non-hero enemies.

skills.name: Brave Assault
skills.description: Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing to the first non-minion enemy hit. Its next basic attack knocks the target into the air for 0.3 seconds.

skills.name: Energy Eruption
skills.description: Fredrinn deals 210 (+100% bonus physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1 second. Striking a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 25 Physical and Spell Defense for 3 seconds and reduces the cooldowns of Piercing Strike and Courageous Assault by 75%. This skill costs 1 combo point.

skills.name: Appraiser's Wrath
skills.description: Fredrinn slams his sword in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 600 plus 21% of his crystal energy as physical damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area after a short delay. Enemies in the center of the area take 175% damage. This skill doubles the conversion rate based on damage dealt to enemy heroes, crystal energy stored in HP. This skill costs 3 combo points.

relationNotes.assist: Fredrinn works best with support heroes, who can further improve his survivability, like Angela and Floryn.
relationNotes.strong: Fredrinn is strong against Mage heroes who rely on skill bursts, as it is difficult for them to one-shot him with their bursts. Instead, once Fredrinn has enough Combo Points, he can use his 2nd Ultimate to easily finish them off. Such as Vale and Eudora.
relationNotes.weak: Fredrinn is countered by Marksman heroes who can deal True Damage, as they can take him down very easily. Heroes like Kerrie and Lesley are good examples here.

name: Freya
title: Valkyrie

skills.name: Power of Einherjar
skills.description: Freya gains 1 holy orb with each basic attack (up to 6 holy orbs). Consuming 1 Holy Orb grants Freya 100% attack speed for her next basic attack (max 6 stacks). Holy orbs gradually recover outside of combat.

skills.name: Leap of Faith
skills.description: Freya jumps towards the target area and slams the ground with her shield, gaining and dealing damage to enemies inside while knocking them into the air for 0.4 seconds.

skills.name: Valkyrie Slash
skills.description: Freya charges forward and strikes, dealing and slowing enemies by 30% for 0.5 seconds. This skill has no base cooldown but consumes 2 Holy Orbs per cast. This skill deals 50% damage to creeps.

skills.name: Valkyrie Descent
skills.description: Freya selects a target area and dives like a Valkyrie (gaining control immunity and 50% damage reduction), dealing and slowing enemies in her path and at the landing point by 40% for 2 seconds. relationNotes.weak: However, all of Freya's skills have movement components, making her vulnerable to Phoveus's unique counter. Using her skills near Phoveus will allow him to quickly gain energy for his enhanced Basic Attacks. name: Gatotkaca
title: Mighty Legend

skills.name: Steel Bones
skills.description: Gatotkaca gains [1] Physical Defense equal to 2% of his HP lost (up to 100). For every 300 damage suffered (calculated before damage reduction), he gains 5 Rage (up to 100). skills.name: Unbreakable
skills.description: Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, forcing enemies in the path to attack and deal damage to him for 1.5 seconds. The sprint distance changes with channel time. Canceling the skill reduces the remaining cooldown by 50%.

skills.name: Avatar of the Guardian
skills.description: Gatotkaca jumps towards the target location, dealing damage to nearby enemies and knocking them into the air for 1 second. relationNotes.weak: Gatotkaca is countered by heroes that can remove CC like Diggie and Wanwan who will greatly reduce his effectiveness.

name: Gloo
title: Swamp Spirits

skills.description: Enemies gain a stack of Sticky whenever they are hit by Gloo's skills, reducing their movement speed by 4% for 6 seconds. Stacks up to 5. Each stack of Sticky on an enemy reduces damage dealt to Gloo by 4%.

skills.name: Slam, Slam
skills.description: Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing damage to the enemy. At the end, there is still a Goo which explodes after 3 seconds to deal with nearby enemies and immobilize them for 1 second. If Gloo touches the Goo, it will immediately explode, reset the skill cooldown, and heal Gloo for 2.5-5% of maximum HP if the explosion hits an enemy (double if it hits an enemy hero).

skills.name: Spread, Spread
skills.description: Gloo splits into Goos, dealing damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and rooting them for 0.5 seconds. When split, Gloo gains 10% movement speed and deals damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies it hits, for 4 seconds. If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo will charge to merge with it, dragging enemies in its path in the same direction for a certain distance.

skills.name: Grab, Grab
skills.description: Unlocked when an enemy hero has full Sticky stacks. Gloo attaches to the targeted enemy hero for up to 9 seconds, recovering 25-30% of their maximum HP. relationNotes.weak: Gloo is countered by Marksman heroes with good mobility. It's difficult for Gloo to attach himself to them, and he can easily be killed if he tries. Such as Karrie and Lesley.

name: Gord
title: Professor of the Mystics

skills.description: After Gord hits an enemy 4 times with basic attacks or skills in a short period of time, the next attack on the target will deal an additional attack and slow them by 20% for 1 second (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).

skills.name: Mystic Projectile
skills.description: Gord summons a mystical orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing damage to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their location for 1 second.

skills.name: Mystic Injunction
skills.description: Gord creates an energy field in the target area, dealing damage every 0.3 seconds to enemies inside (up to 13 times).

skills.name: Mystic Gush
skills.description: Gord releases a beam of energy in the target direction, damaging enemies hit every 0.2 seconds (up to 16 times). The beam direction can be adjusted using the joystick.

relationNotes.assist: Gord works well with tanky heroes with reliable CCs, like Hylos and Belerick.
relationNotes.strong: Gord is strong against melee heroes with poor Mobility, such as Barats and Fredrinn.
relationNotes.weak: Gord is countered by heroes with gap closers, such as Fanny and Lancelot.

name: Granger

Demonic energy cost is not affected by energy cost reductions.

skills.description: Granger quickly fires 6 shots from her weapon, each shot dealing and consuming 70 weapon energy. The last ball is guaranteed at the Crit. Each bullet deals 70 additional damage to Creeps and Minions. While shooting, Granger's movement speed is increased by 15%. Granger stops shooting when he runs out of energy or when the skill is cast again. Rhapsody has a brief cooldown and can be cast once its Gun Energy exceeds 420.

skills.name: Rondo
skills.description: Granger uses her Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15-25% energy to her weapon. Rondo can be cast while channeling Rhapsody. Each time Rhapsody hits an enemy, Rondo's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

skills.name: Death Sonata
skills.description: Granger fires her cannon in the targeted direction, dealing damage to the first enemy Hero hit as well as other targets within the blast radius. relationNotes.weak: Granger is countered by heroes with strong single target killing power. Despite having good mobility, Granger lacks other defensive measures. Heroes like Saber and Hayabusa can quickly get the jump on Granger and finish him off.

name: Grock
title: Fortress Titan

skills.description: Grock gains a shield equal to 10% of his maximum HP and allows the next basic attack to deal an amount equal to % of the target's maximum HP (capped against non-hero units). This effect has a cooldown of 18 to 12 seconds (decreases with level), which decreases by 200% near terrain. Each of his subsequent skills consumes 1 Vengeance Flam to deal 30% more base damage. The effects of Burst Fireball and Searing Torrent can be enhanced. During this time, Valir gains 40% additional movement speed which decays over 3 seconds.

lore: Heir to Fire Throat, fire mage.

relationNotes.assist: Teaming up with Fighters with strong initiation like Khaleed and Yu Zhong can simultaneously enhance the entire team's combat potential.
relationNotes.strong: Valir excels in both sustained damage and Crowd Control. He counters heroes lacking mobility like Balmond and Fredrinn.
relationNotes.weak: Valir is countered by agile Assassins like Lancelot and Fanny because they can easily evade his 1st Skill.

name: Vexana

skills.description: Vexana unleashes a Death Grasp in the targeted direction, damaging enemies in her path. The projectile stops when it hits an enemy hero, terrifying and knocking them back, then it explodes, dealing damage to nearby enemies and terrifying them for 1 second.

skills.name: Cursed Blast
skills.description: Vexana marks the target area with the power of the undead, hitting it after a 0.8 second delay and dealing damage to enemies hit.

skills.name: Eternal Guard
skills.description: Vexana summons an Eternal Guard at the target location, damaging enemies hit and knocking them into the air for 0.8 seconds. The Eternal Guard then joins Vexana in combat for 15 seconds. Each of Eternal Guard's attacks deals [] to enemies in a large area.

lore: The young duchess guarding Necrokeep.

relationNotes.assist: Heroes with powerful CC such as Atlas or high damage output like Beatrix to burst down enemies.
relationNotes.strong: Backline DPS heroes such as Layla, Irithel and Xavier.
relationNotes.weak: Mobile Assassins such as Saber, Aamon and Karina.

name: Wanwan
title: Agile Tiger

skills.name: Tiger Pace
skills.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Wanwan's attacks will have their weaknesses exposed and their position revealed for 5 seconds. When hitting an enemy's weakness, Wanwan deals and increases damage taken from subsequent attacks by 10% for 5 seconds. Wanwan can dash a short distance after each arrow fired from her basic attack. Sprint speed scales with attack speed.

skills.name: Swallow's Path
skills.description: Wanwan launches a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering Tiger Pace while dealing damage to enemies in its path. The fire swallow then transforms into 3 rotating swallow daggers. After a short delay, these Swallow Daggers will return to Wanwan one after the other, dealing damage to enemies on the way back and Slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. Enemies hit twice by the Swallow Dagger are Rooted for 0.5 seconds.

skills.name: Needles in Flowers
skills.description: Wanwan removes all controlling effects on herself and triggers Tiger Pace. During this time, she shoots Deadly Needles in all directions, dealing damage to enemies hit.

skills.name: Crossbow of Tang
skills.description: Wanwan jumps into the air and fires arrows at the targeted enemy hero for 2.5 seconds straight, dealing per arrow. If the target is killed during this attack, Wanwan will switch to another enemy hero within his attack range, gain 30% attack speed, and extend the skill duration by 1 second (this effect can trigger up to 3 times). Wanwan is untargetable and invincible for the duration and can trigger Tiger Pace upon killing an enemy and at the end of the duration. Tang|e's Crossbow can only be thrown at enemy Heroes with all their weaknesses hit and Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed ​​for the duration. This damage is considered base attack damage and the rate of fire scales with Wanwan's attack speed.

lore: The Agile Tiger of the Oriental Fighters and a lively young girl who wields the Crossbow of Tang.

relationNotes.assist: She's best with Supporting Tanks with powerful crowd control, like Franco and Belerick. They can help Wanwan hit more Weaknesses and unlock her Ultimate.
relationNotes.strong: Wanwan is exceptional in dashing and powerful against heroes with short ranges or heavy weight, such as Fredrinn and Luo Yi.
relationNotes.weak: However, due to her lack of durability and short attack range, Mages with longer ranges like Gord can poke her easily. She also lacks survival abilities when taking Burst damage and can be weak against Burst Assassins like Lancelot.

name: X.Borg
title: Firaga Armor

skills.name: Firaga Armor
skills.description: X.Borg's e inherits and absorbs all damage received while active. When the armor is destroyed, X.Borg will disengage from it and roll towards the joystick (he is immune to damage [and control effects] in this process). The armor's energy will gradually regenerate [at a rate of 3 energy per second] while X.Borg is in the unarmored state. At full energy, X.Borg re-equips the armor and restores it to 30% of its [Armor HP]. X.Borg's skills deal real damage when overheated.

skills.name: Fire Missiles
skills.description: X.Borg sprays fire, dealing 7 times over 2 seconds to enemies within range (75% to 100% damage to minions). Unarmored State: The attack area becomes narrower but longer, while the damage is reduced to 60%.

skills.name: Fire Stake
skills.description: X.Borg fires 5 Fire Stakes at the edge of the fan-shaped indicator and collects them after 1.7 seconds, each dealing and pulling enemies in the path towards it. Firaga supplies on the way will also be picked up if hit by fire stakes. Unarmored State: X.Borg adjusts the Fire Stake Launcher to increase its range and shorten the distance between Fire Stakes.

skills.name: Last Insanity
skills.description: X.Borg charges forward in the target direction while spinning and spraying fire, dealing 12 times and slowing enemies by 25%. It stops when encountering an enemy hero and will slow them by an additional 40%. 3 seconds after the skill begins, X.Borg's Firaga armor will explode, dealing [to nearby enemies]. If the armor is destroyed before it can explode on its own, it will only deal 50% damage. When his armor explodes, X.Borg will rush a short distance towards the joystick and enter the unarmored state while removing all debuffs from himself. This skill cannot be used in the unarmored state. Reuse: X.Borg stops spraying fire and immediately explodes his Firaga armor.

lore: An uncontrollable flame that's determined to take revenge against Eruditio.

relationNotes.assist: X.Borg pairs well with heroes who excel in burst damage, such as Karina and Martis. X.Borg's AOE damage will leave enemies low enough for his teammate to finishing off.
relationNotes.strong: X.Borg counters Fighters that lack mobility, such as Terizla and Aulus. His 1st Skill has a large range and can be cast while moving, making it easy for him to kite.
relationNotes.weak: X.Borg is countered by Fighters with burst damage like Martis and Dyrroth. They can quickly burst down X.Borg when he is Armorless.

name: Xavier
title: Defier of Light

skills.name: Transcendence
skills.description: Xavier upgrades his later skills every time his skill hits an enemy hero. Stage I|e: Increases movement speed by 50% when the following skills are hit, decreasing over 1.2 seconds. Stage II|e: The width of later skills will be significantly increased. Stage III: Skill cooldown reduced by 4 seconds (36 seconds for Dawning Light). In stage III, Xavier enters the state of Transcendence. Transcendence: All of Xavier's skills are upgraded to stage III for 5 seconds (this duration is extended by 1 second each time Xavier's skill hits an enemy).

skills.name: Infinite Extension
skills.description: Xavier fires a mystical bullet that deals damage to enemies he passes through. The bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy or the mystical barrier (up to 5 times).

skills.name: Mystic Field
skills.description: Xavier summons a mystical barrier that lasts 5 seconds. Enemies who come into contact with the barrier will gain and be slowed by 50%, while allies will gain additional movement speed which decays over 1.2 seconds. When hit by Xavier's other abilities, the barrier expands into a forbidden field for 3 seconds, dealing damage to enemies inside and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds.

skills.name: Dawning Light
skills.description: Xavier releases a ray of mystical magic that inflicts all enemies in its path. Once cast, it also directly enters the Transcendence|e state and resets the state's duration.

price.other: Obtained via the [[MLBB × Jujutsu Kaisen|MLBB X Jujutsu Kaisen]] event

lore: Former member of the Knights of Light who's determined to forge a path of his own.

relationNotes.assist: He works well alongside heroes that can buff or provide CC to give him more opportunities to deal damage, such as Carmilla and Atlas.
relationNotes.strong: Xavier possesses short cooldowns, a soft CC, good sustainability and performs well against heroes without Blink or burst damage, such as Hanabi and Faramis.
relationNotes.weak: Xavier is countered by heroes with high mobility that can quickly close a gap such as Benedetta, Hayabusa, and Natalia.

name: Yi Sun-shin
title: Paenlong Legend

skills.name: Heavenly Vow
skills.description: Yi Sun-shin attacks with his longbow and sword depending on his distance from the target. Weapon Mastery: After each weapon switch, the next two basic attacks will gain bonus attack speed, dealing 70% and 55% critical damage respectively, and gain 15% movement speed for 1 second.

skills.name: Traceless
skills.description: Yi Sun-shin rushes forward and strikes with his glaive, inflicting and becoming immune to control effects for 1 second. Each Weapon Mastery triggered reduces Traceless' cooldown by 1 second.

skills.name: Blood Floods
skills.description: Tap: Yi Sun-shin quickly strikes with his glaive and deals. Hold: Yi Sun-shin fires a powerful arrow that hits the target. Arrow damage increases with hold time, up to 200%. Yi Sun-shin immediately gains weapon proficiency when this skill is used.

skills.name: Mountain Shocker
skills.description: Yi Sun-shin summons a turtle boat and sees the entire map for 5 seconds. The turtle ship lasts for up to 15 seconds, during which Yi Sun-shin gains 70% burst movement speed (decaying to 20% over 2 seconds). When cast again, Yi Sun-shin commands the turtle boat to rush towards the target area, dealing and stunning enemy units in the central area for 0.8 seconds. Then Yi Sun-shin orders the naval fleet to launch 3 waves of cannon fire over a larger area, each dealing and slowing enemies by 30%. Yi Sun-shin immediately gains the weapon proficiency effect when this skill is used.

lore: Leader of the City of the Dragon Fleet.

relationNotes.assist: Yi Sun-shin works best with Fighters who can initiate, such as Alpha and Khaleed, so he can follow up and unleash his full damage after they have CC'd the enemy.
relationNotes.strong: Yi Sun-shin counters heroes that lack CC like Uranus and Terizla who are at the mercy of his ability to jump in and out of melee range using his 2 weapons.
relationNotes.weak: Yi Sun-shin is countered by heroes with CC skills, such as Franco and Kaja who can lock him down and stop him from freely swapping weapons.

name: Yin
title: Martial Genius

skills.name: Leave It to Me
skills.description: If there are no nearby allies within 4 units, Yin damage is increased to 120% and gains 8% Spell Vamp.

skills.description: Yin gains 60% additional movement speed (decays over 3 seconds). Yin can perform a basic attack that deals damage over time. Upon hitting an enemy with the enhanced basic attack, Yin will launch another charged punch forward, dealing damage to enemies in the way. Successfully throwing a charged punch reduces the skill's cooldown by 35%.

skills.name: Instant Blast
skills.description: Yin rushes forward, leaving the [Golden Rings] behind while dealing damage to enemies along the way. He gains an additional 30% damage reduction for 4 seconds if an enemy hero is hit. After 1 second, the [Golden Rings] will catch up with Yin, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and stunning them for 1 second.

skills.name: My Turn
skills.description: After a short delay, Yin lures an enemy (excluding pets and clone | summoned unit) into her domain for up to 8 seconds and transforms into Lieh. While in the domain, both cannot be affected by other heroes' skills. Lieh has stronger skills and gains 50-80 physical and magic defense which lasts for 8 seconds. The domain will end prematurely if either hero is killed. If Lieh successfully kills the enemy, he will restore 20% of his maximum HP, leave the domain with Frenzy Strike and Instant Blast (Lieh) cooldowns reset, and continue fighting as Lieh for 8 seconds. If Yin fails to pull his target into his domain, the skill will enter a 3 second cooldown.

skills.name: Frenzy Strike
skills.description: Lieh crushes enemies 9 times. During this time, he is immune to control effects and his strike speed gradually increases. Each smash deals 120 (+100% bonus physical attack) physical damage and Slows enemies by 75% for 0.2 sec. After 0.8 seconds, Lieh can move or cast skills to cancel the skill early.

price.other: Obtained via the [[MLBB × Jujutsu Kaisen|MLBB X Jujutsu Kaisen]] event
Obtained via the [[MLBB × Attack on Titan]] event

lore: A young martial artist on a journey to defeat the Evil God that dwells within him.

relationNotes.assist: Yin works best with Supports that can enhance his mobility, such as Mathilda and Rafaela to help him get to the enemy and eliminate key targets.
relationNotes.strong: Yin counters squishy heroes without Blink skills like Layla and Cecilion because they will have a hard time dodging his Golden Rings. Once they are stunned or trapped in his Ultimate, Yin can easily finish them off.
relationNotes.weak: Yin is countered by Fighters that can interrupt skills, such as Fredrinn and Badang, because they can easily interrupt his Ultimate during the initial delay. These heroes can also hold their own in a duel, making them risky targets for Yin's Ultimate.

name: Yu Zhong
title: Black Dragon

skills.name: Cursing Touch
skills.description: Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue to enemy heroes whenever he deals physical damage to them. Sha Residue bursts after reaching 5 charges per target. Then it begins to consume 1 stack every 0.4 seconds to deal equal treatment to the target. Each stack consumed restores 6% of Yu Zhong's lost HP. When Sha Residue erupts, Yu Zhong also gains 30% movement speed for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Dragon Tail
skills.description: Yu Zhong infuses his power into his cloak and transforms it into a weapon, which begins attacking nearby enemies after a short delay. The inner area of ​​the cloak deals, while the sharp edge deals 275% damage and applies 2 stacks of Sha Residue.

skills.name: Soul Grip
skills.description: Yu Zhong releases the Dragon Soul, damaging all enemies in front of him and slowing them by 60% for 1 second. Once the target is hit, Yu Zhong's next basic attack will be enhanced [for 5 seconds], dealing [and behind the target]. (When multiple targets are hit, Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue multiple times with Improved Basic Attack, dealing up to 200% damage.)

skills.name: Black Dragon Form
skills.description: After channeling for 0.6 seconds, Yu Zhong transforms into his black dragon form. For up to 7 seconds, he cannot use any skills but can move freely and will push back enemy heroes on this path while inflicting gains. He also gains Max HP, becomes immune to control effects, and ignores obstacles in this form. Upon leaving Black Dragon form, Yu Zhong enters Dragonoid form, gaining increased range on all of his skills for 10 seconds.

lore: Yu Zhong, the reincarnation of the Black Dragon, intends to unify the Cadia Riverlands through conquest and usher in an era of prosperity.

relationNotes.assist: Yu Zhong works well with Mages that can initiate with CC such as Vexana and Xavier. Their control effects allow Yu Zhong to land his skills more easily.
relationNotes.strong: Yu Zhong counters squishy Fighter heroes such as Aulus and Zilong, because they can't easily dodge Yu Zhong's skills and have a hard time with him in the early game.
relationNotes.weak: Yu Zhong is countered by nimble Marksman heroes such as Lesley and Karrie, since it's hard for Yu Zhong to land his skills, making him a vulnerable and easy target.

name: Yve
title: Astrowarden

skills.name: Galactic Power
skills.description: Yve gains a charge of Galactic Power every time she hits an enemy hero with Void Blast or Void Crystal (up to 10 charges). skills.name: Void Blast
skills.description: Yve blasts Galactic Energy at the target location, dealing damage to enemies in the area. Successfully hitting an enemy grants Yve 55% additional movement speed (halved if a non-hero enemy is hit) which decreases over 1 second.

skills.name: Void Crystal
skills.description: Yve summons a Void Crystal to the target location, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Reuse: Yve commands the crystal to fire materialized energy in the target direction for 2.7 seconds, dealing damage every 0.45 seconds to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit multiple times are slowed by an additional 6% for each hit after the first (up to 60%).

skills.name: Real World Manipulation
skills.description: Yve creates a Starfield|e that lasts [for] 15 seconds, gaining movement immunity and a. During the duration, you can tap or swipe the screen to launch up to 15 attacks. Enemies that exit or enter the Starfield are immobilized for 0.8 seconds (only once against the same target). The Starfield will remain if Yves is controlled, expect removal.

lore: Keeper of the equilibrium of the universe.

relationNotes.assist: Yve's works best with Tanks and Supports with strong CC to lockdown enemies for her Ultimate, like Minotaur, Gatotkaca, and Atlas.
relationNotes.strong: Yve counters Tanks and Fighters with low mobility like Fredrinn, Barats, and Aulus due to her long range skills.
relationNotes.weak: Yve's low survivability makes her a target for divers and burst damage heroes like Yin, Saber, and Karina.

name: Zetian
title: Celestial Empress

skills.name: Celestial Armament
skills.description: Phoenix Crown: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with Phoenix Strike or Phoenix Descent, she gains 0.5% Spell Vamp for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Heavenly Robe: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, pushing back and stunning any enemy hero who dares to approach him while inflicting 90 (+10*Hero Level). She also gains a shield of 300 (+20*hero level) which lasts 3 seconds. This effect has a cooldown of 120 seconds.

skills.name: Phoenix Strike
skills.description: Zetian fires a Phoenix wave in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, it automatically launches another wave, up to 3 times. While casting, Zetian can move with 10% increased movement speed and can use other skills. The three Phoenix Waves respectively deal with //. The third wave hits a larger area and includes a slight pull effect (not considered a control effect). This skill is only 80% effective against minions.

skills.name: Phoenix Descent
skills.description: Zetian summons a Phoenix Spirit to the target location, inflicting and applying a 50% slow effect to enemies in the area. The Spirit of the Phoenix hovers over the location for 3 seconds, dealing every 0.5 seconds and reducing enemies' magic defense by 10%. While the Spirit of the Phoenix is ​​active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge towards a designated location, inflicting and applying a slow effect upon its arrival.

skills.name: Fury of the Phoenix
skills.description: Zetian calls upon his divine mandate and the hearts of his people, granting all allied heroes 60% movement speed which gradually decreases over 3 seconds, while bringing divine smite to all enemy heroes, inflicting and stunning them for 1 second. Zetian gains vision from all enemy heroes during this time. Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.

lore: Recognized by the Heavens and cherished by her people, the Celestial Empress of the Cadia Riverlands ascends to bring peace to the mortal realm.

relationNotes.assist: While Zetian already has decent survivability, when paired with supports who can protect allies like Floryn and Rafaela, Fighters with limited range will struggle even more to approach Zetian. And with the healing from these supports, Zetian can win any ranged battle of attrition.
relationNotes.strong: Zetian's Passive counters melee heroes with limited gap closers like Balmond and Zilong, allowing her to continue poking the enemy from a safe distance.
relationNotes.weak: Zetian's Ultimate can strike down anywhere on the map, but having such a powerful Ult means a hero like Valentina can also use it against Zetian's team.

name: Zhask
title: The King of Swarms

skills.name: Decimation
skills.description: Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied Nightmaric Spawn to the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.

skills.name: Nightmaric Spawn
skills.description: Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn that inherits 55-100% of its attributes (HP, Hybrid Defense, Magic Power). Nightmaric Spawn will automatically attack nearby enemies by firing a death ray at the target, damaging and slowing them by up to 30% for 0.6 seconds. If Zhask is too far from Nightmaric Spawn, he will disappear. Death Ray is considered a basic attack but cannot crit. Improved Fusion: Nightmaric Spawn's damage is increased to 180% and can be repositioned.

skills.name: Mind Eater
skills.description: Zhask fires a mental penetrating missile in the designated direction and deals damage. Next, Nightmaric Spawn will attack enemies with Mind Eater and stun them for 0.5 seconds. Improved Fusion: Increases the damage dealt by Mind Eater by.

skills.name: Dominator's Descent
skills.description: Zhask selects a designated position to summon Nightmaric Spawn and merges with him. Nightmaric Spawn can inherit 100% of its attributes and gain more. His skills improve during the fusion period. Reuse: Zhask immediately leaves the Nightmaric Spawn and loses his upgrade.

lore: King of the Swarm who disrupts the balance of the universe.

relationNotes.assist: Zhask works best with heroes that can lock down enemies so he can have more time to deal damage, like Belerick and Lolita.
relationNotes.strong: Zhask is strong against burst damage heroes like Aldous and Paquito because his high HP after fusing with his Nightmaric Spawn, makes him tough to burst down.
relationNotes.weak: Zhask is countered by agile or long range heroes, such as Pharsa and Cecilion, because they can quickly step out of range of his immobile Nightmaric Spawn.

name: Zhuxin
title: Beacon of Spirits

skills.name: Crimson Butterflies
skills.description: Each time Zhuxin channels Lantern Flare, she converts the mana spent into up to 15 Crimson Butterflies to follow her Spirit Lantern. Once Zhuxin stops channeling Lantern Flare, the Crimson Butterflies will gradually disappear, each restoring 3% of his maximum mana. Zhuxin has a naturally high base Max Mana, but it doesn't scale to his level.

skills.name: Fluttering Grace
skills.description: Zhuxin attacks all enemies in a fan-shaped area and applies 1 stack of Soul Snare. Zhuxin also Slows all enemy Heroes hit by 20-40% and gains 20-40% additional Movement Speed ​​herself for 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Lantern Flare
skills.description: Hold: Zhuxin can move the Spirit Lantern with the skill button, inflicting all enemies within range every 0.33 seconds (magic power increases to 60% against minions) and applying Soul Snare to enemy Heroes hit. Each time (whether it hits a unit or not) consuming 90 Mana. When an enemy hero has 10 charges of Soul Snare, Crimson Butterflies will capture them and pull them into the air for 1 second. Release: Throws all captured enemies towards the target location, dealing +10% to 15% of the target's maximum HP to all enemies in the area. (If an enemy takes damage multiple times, subsequent damage taken will be reduced by 80%.) Once a target is captured, Soul Snare can no longer stack on them for 4 seconds. During this time, this skill deals 15% more damage to that target.

skills.name: Crimson Beacon
skills.description: Zhuxin blinks at the target location while gaining one. When flying, she creates a field around herself for 6 seconds. The field inflicts and applies 1 stack of Soul Snare to enemies every 0.5 seconds.

lore: A mysterious young woman who guides the ember butterflies using her Lantern of Spirits.

relationNotes.assist: Zhuxin can provide great damage and CC, but she can't realize her potential until later in the game, so heroes with CC can help Zhuxin get through the early period. Zhuxin also works well with sustained damage heroes like Belerick, Kimmy, and Cici to dish out a surprising amount of damage.
relationNotes.strong: Zhuxin is a good counter to enemies with less range and low mobility, such as Popol and Kupa and Cyclops, where she has a big advantage.
relationNotes.weak: Like most Mages, Zhuxin is countered by heroes with high mobility and burst, such as Fanny and Saber, who can quickly take her down.

name: Zilong
title: Spear of Dragon

skills.name: Dragon Flurry
skills.description: After dealing damage 3 times with basic attacks or skills, Zilong triggers Dragon Flurry on the next basic attack, hitting the target 3 times. Each hit deals base attack damage and heals itself. Zilong's basic attack deals. If the target's HP is below 50%, all damage dealt by Zilong's skills and basic attacks is increased by 30.

skills.name: Spear Flip
skills.description: Zilong throws the targeted enemy over their head, dealing damage.

skills.name: Spear Strike
skills.description: Zilong lunges at the target enemy, dealing and reducing their Physical Defense by 15-30 for 2 seconds. Spear Strike's cooldown resets every time Zilong kills an enemy.

skills.name: Supreme Warrior
skills.description: Zilong removes all slow effects on himself and gains 40% movement speed, 35-55% attack speed, and immunity to slow for 7.5 seconds. For the duration, he can trigger Dragon Furry every 2 basic attacks (instead of the previous 3).

lore: Guardian of the Dragon Altar and the Oriental Fighter who inherited the Cloud Dragon's power.

relationNotes.assist: Zilong works best with heroes with strong defensive abilities that can hold off enemy attacks while he solos the lane, such as Pharsa and Hanabi.
relationNotes.strong: The immunity to Slow effects that Zilong gets from his Ultimate makes him strong against squishy heroes without CC skills, such as Layla and Lylia.
relationNotes.weak: Zilong is still vulnerable to non-slow CC skills, making him weak against heroes with powerful single-target CC skills, such as Franco and Nana.
